mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, instrument_id, notation_mode, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{instrumentId}, #{notationMode}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE users SET instrument_id = COALESCE(#{instrumentId}, instrument_id), notation_mode = COALESCE(#{notationMode}, notation_mode) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(CONVERT(#{email} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci))

SELECT id, email, password_hash, nickname, instrument_id, notation_mode, status, last_login_at, withdrawal_requested_at, purge_scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'WITHDRAWAL_PENDING')

SELECT id, email, password_hash, nickname, instrument_id, notation_mode, status, last_login_at, withdrawal_requested_at, purge_scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'WITHDRAWAL_PENDING') FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = 'ACTIVE', withdrawal_requested_at = NULL, purge_scheduled_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WITHDRAWAL_PENDING'
UPDATE users SET last_login_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
